plain.name: Plain Jan
plain.bonus: No bonus. Still a very good Jan.
plain.bio: The common Jan. Found in parkas, near fires. Says thank you a lot.

chef.name: Chef Jan
chef.bio: Rarely seen without a ladle. Believes most problems can be solved with soup.

sleepy.name: Sleepy Jan
sleepy.bio: Will absolutely help, after a nap. Eats very little, which is its own kind of help.

spreadsheet.name: Spreadsheet Jan
spreadsheet.bio: Tracks everything, including the trackers. Happiest in a hut with a pencil.

keys.name: Lost-His-Keys Jan
keys.bio: Has lost his keys every winter on record. Finds other things instead.

lumberjack.name: Lumberjack Jan
lumberjack.bio: Speaks fluent tree. Noticeably more productive in a checked shirt.
